card.line: India was the eastern edge of King Xerxes' huge Persian kingdom, the far end of his 127 provinces, which stretched from India to Cush.

moments.title: The edge of Xerxes' kingdom
moments.text: The book of Esther begins by saying that Xerxes ruled 127 provinces from India to Cush. India is named as one end of his huge kingdom.

moments.title: Mordecai's orders go out
moments.text: Mordecai's orders for the Jews were written in the king's name for the 127 provinces from India to Cush. The scribes wrote to each province in its own script, to every people in their own language, and to the Jews in their own script and language.
